worlds.name: Pirate Beach
worlds.description: A sunny beach with a wrecked pirate ship. Count, add and spot clues!

levels.title: Shell Seeker
levels.intro: Kiki spotted shiny shells on the sand. Can you find them all?

levels.title: Coin Counting
levels.intro: Pirates dropped coins on the beach. Let us count them!

levels.title: Sandcastle Sums
levels.intro: The tide is coming. Add up the sandcastle bricks!

levels.title: Treasure Takeaway
levels.intro: Some treasure washed away. How much is left?

levels.title: Spot the Sailor
levels.intro: Two ship pictures look the same, but they are not. Find the differences!

levels.title: Shipwreck Patterns
levels.intro: The old ship has a pattern lock. Finish the pattern to open it.

levels.title: Bigger or Smaller
levels.intro: Weigh the treasure piles. Which one is bigger?

levels.title: Parrot Path
levels.intro: Help the parrot find the golden key on the beach maze!

levels.title: Crab Conga
levels.intro: The crabs are dancing. Copy their moves in the same order!

levels.title: Captain's Chest
levels.intro: The captain's chest has a number lock. Solve the sums to open it!

worlds.name: Mystery Jungle
worlds.description: A misty jungle full of riddles, rivers and hidden things.

levels.title: Animal Words
levels.intro: Jungle animals hid behind letters. Build their names!

levels.title: Vine Patterns
levels.intro: The vines grow in patterns. Finish each one to swing across!

levels.title: Hidden Fruits
levels.intro: Kiki is hungry! Find the hidden fruits in the leaves.

levels.title: Spelling River
levels.intro: Stepping stones with letters cross the river. Spell the food words!

levels.title: Odd One Out
levels.intro: One of these things does not belong. Can you spot it?

levels.title: Trail Maze
levels.intro: The jungle trail twists and turns. Help the monkey reach the banana!

levels.title: Rhyme Time
levels.intro: The parrots sing in rhymes. Find the word that rhymes!

levels.title: Bug Difference
levels.intro: Two jungle pictures hide tiny differences. Find them all!

levels.title: Letter Patterns
levels.intro: Ancient stones show letter patterns. Which letter comes next?

levels.title: Jungle Chief
levels.intro: The Jungle Chief asks you to spell the last secret words.

worlds.name: Crystal Cave
worlds.description: Glowing crystals hum in the dark. Remember the order to light the way!

levels.title: Crystal Echo
levels.intro: The crystals ring in order. Listen, watch and repeat!

levels.title: Glow Sequence
levels.intro: Numbers glow on the cave wall. Which number comes next?

levels.title: Gem Hunt
levels.intro: Real gems hide among the sparkles. Can you find them?

levels.title: Missing Number
levels.intro: A number fell off the cave door. Find the missing one!

levels.title: Long Echo
levels.intro: The echo is longer this time. Stay focused!

levels.title: Cave Tunnel
levels.intro: Follow the twisty tunnels to the crystal at the end.

levels.title: Crystal Differences
levels.intro: Two crystal caves look alike. Find what changed!

levels.title: Pattern Lock
levels.intro: A growing pattern locks the door. Find the rule!

levels.title: Bat Signals
levels.intro: The bats flash signals in the dark. Copy them!

levels.title: Crystal Heart
levels.intro: The Crystal Heart mixes up every kind of pattern. You can do it!

worlds.name: Ancient Temple
worlds.description: Old machines and symbols guard the temple. Use science and logic!

levels.title: Solar Symbols
levels.intro: The temple ceiling shows the sky. Answer the star riddles!

levels.title: Temple Multiplication
levels.intro: Stone wheels turn when you solve the times tables.

levels.title: Stone Sequences
levels.intro: Carved numbers form a secret sequence. Which number is next?

levels.title: Nature's Secrets
levels.intro: Temple gardens hold secrets about plants and animals.

levels.title: Mechanism Maze
levels.intro: Slide through the old mechanism to reach the golden key.

levels.title: Water and Weather
levels.intro: The water channel needs you to know how weather works.

levels.title: Rune Differences
levels.intro: Two rune walls look alike. Find what changed!

levels.title: Riddle of Numbers
levels.intro: The stone tablet asks number riddles. Read carefully!

levels.title: Body and Senses
levels.intro: A statue asks how your body and senses work.

levels.title: Temple Guardian
levels.intro: The Temple Guardian asks a bit of everything. Show what you know!

worlds.name: Treasure Island
worlds.description: The final island. Read the map, follow the compass and open the treasure lock!

levels.title: Compass Rose
levels.intro: Learn the compass! North is up. Follow the directions to the spot.

levels.title: Map Reading
levels.intro: Look at the island map and say which way things are.

levels.title: Lost Coins
levels.intro: Coins were lost all over the island. Solve the sums to get them back!

levels.title: Island Words
levels.intro: Build the words that describe the island.

levels.title: Continents and Oceans
levels.intro: Kiki wants to know about our whole world. Answer her geography quiz!

levels.title: Follow the Compass
levels.intro: A longer trail of compass directions leads to buried treasure.

levels.title: Memory Locks
levels.intro: The treasure gate remembers a secret order. Repeat it!

levels.title: Treasure Trail
levels.intro: Treasure is hidden among lookalikes. Find the real thing!

levels.title: Secret Map
levels.intro: The secret map mixes geography and directions. Read it carefully!

levels.title: The Treasure Lock
levels.intro: The final lock needs a long compass path. Follow it to the treasure!
